timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I feel low on energy this morning.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Part of me doesn’t want to get going yet.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: My mind feels foggy and slow.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I notice how tempting it is to stay still.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels heavy this morning.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m not sure I have the energy for today.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me wants to just go back to bed.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that mornings are hard for me.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: Getting started feels like the hardest part.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can start slow and still get moving.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I don’t need full energy to take the first step.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: My mind can wake up gradually.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can let this grogginess pass as I move.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can wake up a little more with each breath.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to ease into today.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can find one small thing to look forward to.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to build momentum instead of forcing it.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This morning can turn around from here.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I’m capable of showing up for today.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I trust that my energy will build as I go.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to feel good about getting started.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can meet today with a clear mind.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels more awake and ready.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m creating momentum with every step I take.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can carry this energy into whatever’s next.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to feel motivated, even on slow mornings.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to make today a good one.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, a little more awake than before. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this energy with you as you begin your day.
